title: PFCP: refactor grouped IE decoding
description:
This MR simplifies the code to dissect grouped-IEs.

All grouped IEs are decoded the exact same way and can be decoded by the same function. Nonetheless a separate function was used for each separate IE.

The grouped-IE code is refactored and all superfluous wrappers are removed.

(backported from merge-request !9363)

notes.body:
Hi,

We backport only bug fix and not enhancement
Ok, did not know that yet.

commits_data.title: PFCP: remove empty wrappers around dissect_pfcp_grouped_ie
commits_data.message:
PFCP: remove empty wrappers around dissect_pfcp_grouped_ie

By simplifying the dissect_pfcp_grouped_ie calls, some dissector
functions have become a simple wrapper to dissect_pfcp_grouped_ie
with even the same arguments.

These functions are removed and the dissect_pfcp_grouped_ie function is
used directly where references to these old functions were used
previsouly.

(cherry picked from commit fadb4207699d01b1759bdbcd6f32eb7594a65cad)

commits_data.title: PFCP: get rid of forward declarations by moving ie-decoder-table down
commits_data.message:
PFCP: get rid of forward declarations by moving ie-decoder-table down

Part of cleanup that will ease refactorings in later commits.
Remove all forward declarations and move the table containing references
to those functions down.

(cherry picked from commit b5fc7ff3bc359d88b9df4a3d8b5e6d93b6ebb9e4)

commits_data.title: PFCP: remove redundant sub-tree and sub-tvb
commits_data.message:
PFCP: remove redundant sub-tree and sub-tvb

The dissector-code for grouped IEs creates a subtree while it already
received a subtree for the ett being used. This redundant subtree
creation is removed.

The same happens with creating a tvb: the function creates a new tvb
while it already is passed in the appropriate tvb.

(cherry picked from commit bf071e39d98bfb32c84548b47e626b7f54aaa1df)
